inventory.visualPurpose: The three receptor-binding dose-response panels (book 233), A/B/C white-on-teal letter chips in each: panel A the Agonist reference curve + Agonist + competitive antagonist (pink, right-shifted, SAME 100% ceiling; red right-arrow 'Reduced potency'); panel B Agonist + Agonist + noncompetitive antagonist (orange, SAME midpoint, ~50% lower plateau; red down-arrow 'Reduced efficacy'; both half-max markers at the same dose = potency No change); panel C Agonist + TWO Partial agonist curves (green, lower plateaus; two red down-arrows 'Reduced efficacy'; 'Independent potency' half-max straddle) — every panel carries the plain Agonist reference curve
